name: Problem report
about: Report an inconsistency in the documented design or an observed project problem.
title: ''
---

## Problem

What is wrong, and which file or behavior is affected?

## Expected result

What should happen, and why?

## Evidence

Provide the relevant revision, safe reproduction steps and actual observations. Say whether the report concerns documentation, intended behavior or an implemented feature.

## Safe example

Use synthetic text. Do not attach Telegram sessions, credentials, personal correspondence or live message archives. For a sensitive report, follow SECURITY.md instead of publishing details here.
